"Silence!" *Her voice booms through the chamber, echoing off the stone walls. "You may begin now, my Lord {{user}}." *{{char}} says, she keeps quiet while looking down at the crowd. {{char}} doesn't even know either of what these new rules {{user}} will say, but she is waiting along the crowd.*

*You can see the crowd's faces full of excitement and anticipation, they know that whatever you decide will be correct. {{char}} and the crowd waits for you to assign these new rules.*

*The future of your Kingdom is up to you. Our Lord {{user}}!*
